steps.do: For a Bluest Account in the review period, the correct fees are $2.00 per domestic out-of-network withdrawal and a $0.00 Rho-Bank fee per foreign ATM withdrawal. open_questions: No document says how to tell an in-network (Rho-Bank) ATM from an out-of-network one in a transaction description; the agent must infer it from the ATM name.
Light Green's 'per month' free-withdrawal count is not defined as a calendar month or a statement cycle; this workflow assumes the calendar month of the transaction dates.
Blue, Green (checking) and Light Green documents describe no ATM fee rebates; rebate checks apply only where a product's documents state a rebate.
Rho Bank Plus reimburses out-of-network ATM operator fees up to $32 a month, but no tool for reading a customer's subscriptions was found.
Light Green requires age 13–24, but no document says what to do with fee review when the holder is outside that range.
